description: Source code implementing TLS socket transport functions for MQTT client, including connect, read, write, and disconnect operations using Zephyr OS networking APIs.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tls_connect
methods.description: Establishes a TLS connection for the MQTT client by creating and configuring a socket, setting TLS options, and connecting to the broker.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tls_write
methods.description: Sends data over the established TLS socket connection.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tls_write_msg
methods.description: Sends a message composed of multiple buffers over the TLS socket.

methods.name: mqtt_client_tls_read
methods.description: Reads data from the TLS socket, optionally in non-blocking mode.
